title: Transport Bill Generator
name: Transport Bill
summary: Goods consignment note with consignor, consignee, weight and freight.
description: Generate a goods transport bill or consignment note with origin and destination, consignor and consignee, number of articles, weight and to-pay or paid freight. Preview instantly and download as PDF.
intro: A transport bill, also called a consignment note, covers goods carried by road. It shows the origin and the destination, the consignor and the consignee, the number of articles, the weight and the freight, to pay or paid.

print.note_labour: Note: the delivery office will charge labour and delivery charges separately from the freight.
print.note_insurance: Please insure valuable goods fully; the transporter is not liable for loss.
print.note_validity: This receipt is valid for 5 days from the booking date only. Please take delivery from the transport godown on time.
print.note_docs: Any transport documents required by law (such as an E-way bill in India) must be provided by the consignor, who is responsible for losses caused by missing documents.
